question: Which city will host 2028 Olympics games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Los Angeles, USA**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Los Angeles, USA** will host the 2028 Olympic Games.
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) announced Los Angeles as the host city for the 2028 Summer Olympics on September 13, 2017.
 
• This will be the third time Los Angeles has hosted the Olympic Games, previously hosting in 1932 and 1984.
 
• Los Angeles was awarded the 2028 Olympics after an agreement was reached with Paris, which will host the 2024 Olympics.
 
• The decision was part of the IOC's new process to ensure the long-term stability of the Olympic Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Olympic Games** are a major international multi-sport event held every four years, featuring summer and winter sports competitions.
 
• The Games are overseen by the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)**, which was established in 1894.
 
• Los Angeles is known for its strong sports culture, with numerous professional sports teams and world-class facilities.
 
• The 2028 Olympics are expected to bring significant economic benefits to the city and further enhance its global reputation.
 
• Los Angeles' bid for the Olympics emphasized sustainability, the use of existing venues, and the involvement of local communities.
